messages.author: 730aa98b7fdf9625
messages.subject: Still get "Error: object '.setDummyField' not found"
parts:
Hi!

I'm running Shiny 0.6.0 with R 3.0.1 on a Windows 7 (64bit) machine. Today, an update through CRAN came for httpuv (1.1.0), and now I keep getting the message:

Error: object '.setDummyField' not found

I've tried downgrading to httpuv 1.0.6.3, but the problem persists!

Any ideas?

Thanks!

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: Still get "Error: object '.setDummyField' not found"
parts:
Hi, can you send the output of your sessionInfo()?

Also, I suggest re-installing Shiny from CRAN - it's possible that your copy of Shiny was built on a different version of R (that's where we've seen these errors in the past).

-Winston
